name: Grizzled Ranger (Human Ranger 8)
body:
Grizzled Ranger
CR 7

XP 3,200

Male Middle-aged Human Ranger 8

CG Medium Humanoid

Init +2 (+6 in Forests; +4 in Mountains) Senses Perception + 13 (+17 in Forests; +15 in Mountains)

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat 10 (+2 Dex)
hp 68 (currently 0; 8d10+8 Favored Class + 16 CON)
Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +4;

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +8 (1d3 nonlethal)
Special Attacks Favored Enemy (Dragon +2, Giant +4)

Ranger Spells Prepared: (CL 5th, all spells have been cast)

2nd – Cure Light Wounds (2)

1st – Animal Messenger, Speak with Animals

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 11, Wis 14, Cha 9
Base Atk +8; CMB +8; CMD 20
Feats Deadly Aim, Endurance B, Improved Precise Shot B, Manyshot B, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot
Skills Climb +7, Handle Animal +10, Knowledge (Geography) +7, Knowledge (Nature) +7, Perception + 13, Ride +13, Stealth +13, Survival +13 (+17 when tracking), Swim +7
Languages Common, Elven, Giant
SQ Animal Companion, Favored Terrain (Forrest + 4, Mountain +2), Swift Tracker, Wild Empathy +7, Woodland Stride
Gear none

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Animal Companion (Ex)

Black Bear: N Medium Animal; Init: +6, Senses: Low-light Vision, Scent, Perception +7; DEFENSE: AC 15, touch 12, flat 13 (+2 Dex, +3 natural); hp 37 (5d8+15); Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +4, Evasion; OFFENSE: move 40 ft; attack: Bite +8 (1d6+5) and 2 Claws +8 (1d4+5); STATS: STR 20, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6; BAB +3, CMB +8, CMD 20 (24 vs. trip); Feats: Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Iron Will; Skills: Perception +7, Stealth +7; SQ: Link, Share Spells

Prisoner (n/a)

The Adventure assumes that this character is imprisoned with 0 hit points, all spells cast, and no equipment. If used outside of the Adventure, use the following changes:

Recommended Gear: +1 Shock Composite Long Bow (story item), Chain Shirt, Long Sword, Quiver with 20 arrows

Equiped Stats: AC: 16, touch 12, flat 14 (+4 Armor, +2 Dex)

Melee: Long Sword +8/+3 (1d8)

Ranged: +1 Shock Composite Long Bow +11/+6 (1d8+1+1d6 electricity)
